created_keys.retention_policy: Keep highest‑salience items; drop lowest‑scoring when budget is exceeded. Apply a time‑based decay factor (e.g., 0.9 per cycle) to salience. Low‑priority entries also have a TTL (e.g., 24 h) before removal.
created_keys.summarization: Compress older dialogue into brief summaries or vector embeddings, store only these representations in long‑term storage, and retrieve them for context when needed.
created_keys.pruning_strategy: Tiered memory: a fast primary buffer (e.g., last N turns or until token limit) plus a secondary store that is periodically compressed. Retention is driven by a salience score that decays over time and is boosted for goals, decisions, and entities. When the token budget is exceeded, lowest‑scoring items are dropped.
